description: This file defines the EndpointList class which manages a list of service endpoints, supporting operations such as retrieving active endpoints, expired endpoints, and removing endpoints. It appears to be part of the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically related to endpoint discovery.

classes.name: EndpointList
classes.description: A class managing active and expired endpoint URLs, providing methods to retrieve, expire, and remove endpoints.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EndpointList with a list of endpoints, setting the active list.

methods.name: getActive
methods.description: Returns an unexpired active endpoint URL, or null if none are available.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns an active endpoint if available, otherwise returns an expired endpoint, or null if none are available.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an endpoint from both active and expired lists by key.

methods.name: getExpired
methods.description: Returns an expired endpoint URL, or null if none are available.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Advances the internal pointer of the provided array, resetting if at the end.
